49ers.interpretation: Exact pre-state chart probabilities against a uniform cohort defense mixture. Numeric means are conditional, not whole-play YPA. Penalty choice, recovery advances, return clipping, touchdown distance and stateful scoring remain explicitly pending. Special return columns are conditioned on a return lookup. FG curves retain penalty/block/fumble mass as unresolved and precede re-kicks. Unparseable B/QT cells use the core's uniform random fallback; its probability is reported separately and is not historical evidence. No independent historical route or distance accuracy is asserted.
